name: Algolia
description: Algolia lets agents search indices, read and update index settings, and check search analytics in the applications that the signed-in user can access. Each user signs in to their own Algolia account through the browser.

prompts.text: Which search queries returned no results last week?
Show the searchable attributes and ranking settings of the products index.
Search the products index for 'running shoes' and explain the ranking.

apps.name: Algolia
apps.description: Index search, settings, and analytics, over Algolia's MCP server with browser sign-in.
